Codex should run the bundled inknb connect --name <session name> --role <role> command from its own shell to use its current CODEX_THREAD_ID. Other agents supply their own sessionId. Replies never change prose. Returns pendingRequests with every unanswered human message assigned to you in this aside, including messages sent while you worked. Continue handling them before ending your turn. Reply by each requestId; one reply never answers other requests. Set awaitingHuman true when asking for a human choice. Reuse the same messageId when retrying. Set status working for acknowledgements and progress. Set status complete only after finishing all work and creating any suggestions. Complete replies close automatically when no human choice or suggestion is pending. To continue work in another aside, create it first and pass continuedIn; the original closes with a link. Working replies keep the request active and allow a final reply later. Keep the answer to 100 words. Put longer Markdown explanations in details. Details open in the full response reader and never enter the manuscript.

The old version becomes superseded and cannot be accepted. Keep the returned suggestion threadId. Do not create a second suggestion and link it as superseding the old one. Requires current revision and expectedText. No edit access is needed. Supply annotationId to act directly on a queued annotation. A discussion is created only for annotation_create. Suggestions link back to the annotation.
